Larger fleet is unaccepted; structured choices do not prove deep open-ended investigation quality.

Findings remain separate from bank action authority. Broad upstream sandbox security and larger-fleet recovery are not independently established here.

reproducible_engineering.reason: Source/image/compiler hashes, immutable qualification receipts, frozen workloads, replay scripts and preserved failures are strong. Public source pins match current bytes. Some foundational raw histories are private; historical qualification does not attest this whole release.

developer_usability.reason: README route, source map, reproduction matrix and contracts are useful. Many archival pins and setup paths add review burden; a complete current generic-foundation reproduction is outside this repository.
